$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Bytes that arrive without a current artifact reference are a harmless discard

rejection.rule: Generated bytes are accepted only while the current state references the exact session, visual job, image identity, and first-announcement revision. Bytes without a current reference are stale and harmless. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2, §9)
rejection.effect: The phone drops the bytes without rendering, without clearing unrelated coaching lanes, and without a protocol error.

summary: The desktop sends a visual_guidance_image_v2 binary frame while the current coaching state references no available artifact. There is no current reference, so the bytes are a harmless discard.

steps.note: Accepted sessionId and the visual bundle. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: Current state references no available artifact. There is no current reference for any generated bytes. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2)
Bytes arrive with no current artifact reference. The phone drops them harmlessly. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2, §9)

outcome: No image is rendered. Unrelated coaching lanes remain valid. No protocol error is required for a stale/uncorrelated binary frame.
